# pve_firewall_options (Resource)

Firewall options singleton at cluster, node, vm, or container scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_firewall_options" "example" {
scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `node`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `dhcp` (Boolean) Enable DHCP. (default: 0)
- `ebtables` (Boolean) Enable ebtables rules cluster wide. (default: 1)
- `enable` (Number) Enable or disable the firewall cluster wide. (default: 0)
- `ipfilter` (Boolean) Enable default IP filters. This is equivalent to adding an empty ipfilter-net<id> ipset for every interface. Such ipsets implicitly contain sane default restrictions such as restricting IPv6 link local addresses to the one derived from the interface's MAC address. For containers the configured IP addresses will be implicitly added.
- `log_level_forward` (String) Log level for forwarded traffic. One of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `log_level_in` (String) Log level for incoming traffic. One of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `log_level_out` (String) Log level for outgoing traffic. One of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `log_nf_conntrack` (Boolean) Enable logging of conntrack information. (default: 0)
- `log_ratelimit` (String) Log ratelimiting settings
- `macfilter` (Boolean) Enable/disable MAC address filter. (default: 1)
- `ndp` (Boolean) Enable NDP (Neighbor Discovery Protocol). (default: 1)
- `nf_conntrack_allow_invalid` (Boolean) Allow invalid packets on connection tracking. (default: 0)
- `nf_conntrack_helpers` (String) Enable conntrack helpers for specific protocols. Supported protocols: amanda, ftp, irc, netbios-ns, pptp, sane, sip, snmp, tftp
- `nf_conntrack_max` (Number) Maximum number of tracked connections. (default: 262144)
- `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` (Number) Conntrack established timeout. (default: 432000)
- `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_syn_recv` (Number) Conntrack syn recv timeout. (default: 60)
- `nftables` (Boolean) Enable nftables based firewall (tech preview) (default: 0)
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `nosmurfs` (Boolean) Enable SMURFS filter.
- `policy_forward` (String) Forward policy. One of: `ACCEPT`, `DROP`.
- `policy_in` (String) Input policy. One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `policy_out` (String) Output policy. One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `protection_synflood` (Boolean) Enable synflood protection (default: 0)
- `protection_synflood_burst` (Number) Synflood protection rate burst by ip src. (default: 1000)
- `protection_synflood_rate` (Number) Synflood protection rate syn/sec by ip src. (default: 200)
- `radv` (Boolean) Allow sending Router Advertisement.
- `smurf_log_level` (String) Log level for SMURFS filter. One of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `tcp_flags_log_level` (String) Log level for illegal tcp flags filter. One of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `tcpflags` (Boolean) Filter illegal combinations of TCP flags. (default: 0)
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: scope/node/vmid (also the `terraform import` format).
